summary: Verified MOD Code → TL Auto-fill feature end-to-end. Backend unit tests (13/13 pass) confirm match_by_mod_code maps all required MOD codes (MOD-Tread→2A, MOD-Rowing→4A, MOD-Spin→3A, MOD-Bench→5A, MOD-Strength→20A, MOD-Multi2→23A, MOD-Bike→18A, 'mod ubike'→18A; MOD-Unknown→None; normalisation tolerant of spaces / mixed case). Frontend wizard (CRM → Corporate mode → Quotes → 'MOD Service Quote' → Kifaru Base (57 items) → Type A → Load Equipment) correctly auto-mapped ALL 57 lines by MOD Code: API returned status 200 with mod_code_matched_count=57, matched_count=57, every line source='mod_code' confidence=1.0 with non-null rate_card_id, tl_number and mod_code. Header shows 'mod-autocode-summary' = '57 auto-matched by MOD Code'; 57 cyan 'mod-line-autocode-*' badges rendered (samples: MOD-BENCH → TL 5A, MOD-UBIKE → TL 18A, MOD-STRENGTH → TL 20A, MOD-STEPPER → TL 16A, MOD-MULTI2 → TL 23A, MOD-XTP → TL 9A confirmed). SOR Line dropdowns pre-selected 20/20 sampled with unit prices filled (£157.20, £145.12, etc). Verified sample TLs from spec: MOD-SPIN=3A (10 items), MOD-STEPPER=16A (2 items), MOD-XTP=9A (4 items). PDF (Pulse template, MOD-20260806-7E87 quote with 5 lines) generated 122KB with TL No. column populated (2A / 4A / 18A / —), SER references beneath descriptions (PAT SER100135 etc), line items rendered — NOT 'No line items.'
